description: System families from brief §3-§45 with honest status. 'implemented' requires test ids that exist in tests/. 'blocked' records state the blocker.

records.name: Input, rebinding, and settings persistence
records.notes: Keyboard/mouse and basic gamepad. Controller rebinding, hold/tap variants, and aim assist are gaps.

records.name: Clock, fixed step, and local time scale
records.notes: Day length is provisional (48 real minutes). Slow motion is a timeline only; no ability uses it yet.

records.name: On-foot locomotion (walk, jog, sprint, jump, fall)
records.notes: No vaults, ladders, stairs, swimming, ragdoll, or parachute yet.

records.name: Static box collision and raycasts
records.notes: Boxes only. No heightfield terrain, no step-up, no roof walking.

records.name: Third- and first-person cameras with wall clipping
records.notes: No shoulder aim, scoped aim, cinematic or activity cameras, lock-on, recentering, or FP vehicle dashboards/mirrors.

records.name: Cell streaming with look-ahead and collision coverage
records.notes: Synchronous data generation; mesh builds are throttled. No async worker loading yet.

records.name: Procedural test district (original geometry)
records.notes: Grid of blocks and roads, boxes for buildings. No lanes, signals, sidewalks as geometry, water, or interiors.

records.name: Car driving model (one sports car)
records.notes: Provisional numbers. Not calibrated against a reference. No suspension, damage deformation, tyres, or other classes.

records.name: Vehicle entry, exit, and owner field
records.notes: Single personal vehicle. No storage, impound, insurance, duplication guards, or carjacking.

records.name: Versioned save slots, migration, and recovery
records.notes: One slot used by quick save. Autosave, multiple slots in UI, and cloud save are gaps.

records.name: Three story protagonists (data and per-character save state)
records.notes: Only Eli Mercer is playable. Switching, AI for inactive characters, and abilities are not implemented.

records.name: HUD (clock, health, stamina, speed, prompts, objective)
records.notes: Implemented in the browser build but not covered by automated tests; visual check blocked unless a headless browser is installed (see docs/TEST_REPORT.md).

records.name: Wanted levels, witnesses, and pursuit
records.blocker: Milestone B. Needs crime events, perception, and traffic/pedestrian AI, none of which exist yet.

records.name: Traffic and pedestrian life
records.blocker: Milestone B. Needs lane graph data and an AI population budget.

records.name: Weapons, damage, and cover
records.blocker: Milestone B. Weapon numbers are unresearched; no reference measurement is available.

records.name: Mission runtime (objective graph, checkpoints)
records.blocker: Milestone C. Needs the objective graph runtime; the catalog is only a seed.

records.name: Story and Online heists
records.blocker: Milestones C and F. Depends on the mission runtime, multiplayer authority, and the economy ledger.

records.name: Typed transaction ledger (Online)
records.blocker: Milestone E. Requires the authoritative server and atomic idempotent transactions.

records.name: Online sessions and authority
records.blocker: Milestone E. No server exists in this build; the feature gate is closed.

records.name: Audio (engines, footsteps, music, dialogue)
records.blocker: No audio is implemented. Original audio assets are not yet produced.

records.name: Phone, map, and radio
records.blocker: Milestone B. No content or UI exists yet.

records.name: Water, swimming, weather, day-night visuals
records.blocker: Milestone B. Only a simple day-night sky tint exists; no weather or water.

records.name: Creator, mission editor, and content tools
records.blocker: Milestone G. Editors are not built; registries are JSON and validated by tools/validate-registries.ts.
